steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Provide the mandatory event title so the create flow can proceed.
Replace the default Auction stage with RFQ only.
Ensure the RFQ stage is active before selecting its template and adding items.
Choose the RFQ template required before adding line items.
Open the Items flow, add the named product, enter quantity 10, and save the drawer.
Select the required delivery location for the added line item.
Verify the selected delivery location is retained.
Verify that saving the item flow leaves one line item and the Items control reflects Items 1.
